liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Standing On The Moon** (2 reviews): Garcia screamed intensely during this number, though the SBD recording does not fully capture it; The reviewer considers this performance the best version of the song ever recorded [12][18]
- **Drums** (1 review): The reviewer specifically recommends listening to the end of this track [16]
- **Black Muddy River** (1 review): A real horn is audible during this song, despite Clarence Clemons not being officially noted [17]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd89-12-06 s1t01 Crowd**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd89-12-06 s1t02 Shakedown Street**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd89-12-06 s1t03 Walkin' Blues**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd89-12-06 s1t04 Friend Of The Devil**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd89-12-06 s1t05 Queen Jane Approximately**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd89-12-06 s1t06 Jack-A-Roe**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd89-12-06 s1t07 Just A Little Light**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd89-12-06 s1t08 Victim Or The Crime**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]

## The recordings

- **gd1989-12-06.142700.fob.schoeps.cmc3.mk4.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): audience recording; 22 songs; 166 min [1]
- **gd89-12-06.sbd.miller.14917.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 159 min; rated 3.79/5 by 24 [2]. Said about its sound: The recording quality is described as excellent, though the dead organization restricted downloads [18]
- **gd1989-12-06.172203.nak700.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 19 songs; 159 min [3]
- **gd1989-12-06.sbd.miller.tetzeli.fix-14917.33821.reflac.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 158 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [5]

## Around the show

- The reviewer noticed people dancing during the tuning and secured a bus spot in Terrapin [13]
- The concert served as a benefit for the earthquake that struck the bay area that fall [16]
- This was the first Bay Area show after the earthquake, with a Shakedown Street opener [20]
- The tuning noise before Shakedown Street was actually much longer and more intense live [20]
- The benefit coincided with the twentieth anniversary of the Altamont festival [22]
- Jerry brought Clarence Clemons out for the second set, causing tension with Bob [23]
- Clarence Clemons performed with the band from Ship Of Fools through the end of the show [1]
- Clarence Clemons joined the band for Ship Of Fools, Terrapin Station, and Space [3]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1989-12-06.142700.fob.schoeps.cmc3.mk4.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Ted Mattes; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source Info: Ted Mattes' Master (FOB)Audience Dat; Schoeps CMC3/MK4 mics > Aerco PreAmp (w/ Oade capacitor mod) > Panasonic SV-250 (16-bit/48k);… [1]. Also: A Sennheiser 421 source supplied a thirty-second patch in Standing On The Moon [1]
- **gd89-12-06.sbd.miller.14917.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD -> Dat (Encore is SBD>Cm>Dat with AUD Patch starting at 4:16)Transfer Info:Dat (Sony R500) -> Prodif Plus -> Samplitude v6.0 -> SHN(2 Discs SHN / 3 Discs… [2]. Also: The reviewer listened to a secret, unannounced live radio broadcast on KPFA; Charlie Miller transferred and edited the Sony R500 DAT using Prodif Plus and Samplitude [2][22]
- **gd1989-12-06.172203.nak700.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Bob Wagner's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 (w/ Bass EQ) > Sony TC-D5M (Maxell XLIIS/Dolby B) [3]. Also: A Schoeps CMC3 MK4 source supplied a fifty-three second patch in the Drums section [3]
- **gd1989-12-06.sbd.miller.tetzeli.fix-14917.33821.reflac.flac16**: transferred by Bill Tetzeli; source: Fix of shnid 14917 [5]. Also: Charlie Miller provided overlap data to make the transition between disks two and three seamless [5]
